cases.prompt: Payments are sometimes recorded twice when RabbitMQ redelivers a message. Make the handler in billing/consumer.py idempotent.

files.billing/consumer.py:
from faststream.rabbit import RabbitRouter

from billing.ledger import Ledger, PaymentCaptured


def build_router(*, ledger: Ledger) -> RabbitRouter:
    router = RabbitRouter()

    @router.subscriber("payments.captured")
    async def on_payment_captured(event: PaymentCaptured) -> None:
        await ledger.record(event)

    return router
